notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has lost life this turn
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
